change.DomainGovernancePort: owner_reads=True default reads GET /api/governance/freeze-orders and /rollbacks via governance_approval_url with caller auth, remaining management deadline and request-scoped cached_owner_call (unchanged).
change.tenant_policy: row.tenant_id / actor / metadata are never tenant proof. FREEZE rows are visible only when the tenant-guarded Evolution owner GET /api/evolution/proposals/{id} resolves their evolution_decision_id to a decision in the verified caller tenant (action_type freeze, target id/version match, execution_ref_id if stored equals freeze_order_id); freeze rows without a decision stay unresolved. ROLLBACK rows (ALL of them, regardless of optional evolution_decision_id / execution_ref_id / target metadata) are proven only by the server-scoped Runtime resource READ: every runtime_id/runtime_binding_id on the row must resolve to exactly one binding in the caller-tenant GET {PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_URL}/api/runtime-bindings list (core.owner_reads.read_records, request-cached), with no contradictory row tenant claim. Missing/ambiguous/contradictory/failed lookup => unresolved (never shown, never assigned a tenant). No Evolution read is issued for rollback rows. No writer, backfill, new field or Plan GET.
change.ReadSurfacePorts: get_rollbacks (raises on owner failure) and list_all_rollbacks now reads the canonical Governance ledger (no loop_runs pseudo-rollbacks, no swallow-to-empty); dataset_source(freeze_orders|all_rollbacks) reports the real owner outcome
